description: Angular component class for configuring knob widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, default settings, and input/output preparation.

classes.name: KnobControlWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing knob widget settings, extending WidgetSettingsComponent, with form controls and configuration logic.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: prepareInputSettings
methods.description: Prepares and returns input settings for the widget, cloning and augmenting settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.
